relationship_to_prior_map: This activates the previously deferred canonical annual Amihud characteristic without silently converting it to a monthly factor. The later candle-derived strategy, if any, is an A-share adaptation and must be named separately.
economic_hypothesis: Stocks with high realized price impact per unit currency turnover may earn a future illiquidity-risk premium, but the long leg must be established directly under A-share execution and capacity semantics.

formation.decision_time: Close of the last market session of the preceding calendar year.
formation.lookback: All valid traded sessions in the preceding calendar year only.
formation.daily_measure: abs(causal coordinate step_return) / reported RMB amount; no arbitrary scale multiplier changes rank order
formation.annual_measure: Arithmetic mean of the valid daily measure.
formation.mother_selection: Within the complete eligible decision-date cross-section, deterministic descending NTILE(5); retain quintile 1 (highest annual Amihud illiquidity).

label_only_execution.entry: first legal non-limit-up open in signal_cal_idx+1 through signal_cal_idx+3
label_only_execution.exit: first legal non-limit-down open on or after entry_cal_idx+120

market_context.construction: Causal 20/60-session broad-market median state known at the decision close.

success_gate_after_chart_rule_freeze.if_pass: Freeze unchanged and open portfolio years 2022-2024.
success_gate_after_chart_rule_freeze.if_fail: Close without threshold, quintile, horizon, or regime rescue and continue to a different economic mother family.

governance.development_history: 2014-2021 context supporting 2015-2020 signals and H120 labels
